result.instructions: Tools for Timeneye, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Log 90 minutes on the Website redesign project for today."; "List all unbilled time entries for client Acme this month."; "Which users have time-off requests waiting for approval?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Timeneye data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timeneye_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timeneye_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timeneye_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timeneye_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timeneye_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the Timeneye account the token belongs to: name, trial and expiry dates, user limit and billing status. Good first call to check the connection. API: GET /account.

tools.name: timeneye_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the members of the account, with status and group membership. Use it to find a user_id for other tools. API: GET /users.

text.description: Full-text search over the user's name and email.

client_ids.description: Only users in projects of these clients.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort by (see the API reference for allowed values).

tools.name: timeneye_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients (customers) of the account. Use it to find a client_id for projects and entries. API: GET /clients.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort by (see the API reference for allowed values).

tools.name: timeneye_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client by id. API: GET /clients/{client}.

tools.name: timeneye_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects, with client, billable flag, active state and budget fields. Use it to find a project_id for time entries. API: GET /projects.

user_id.description: Only projects where this user is in the team.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort by (see the API reference for allowed values).

tools.name: timeneye_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project by id, including its team and budget. API: GET /projects/{project}.

tools.name: timeneye_list_phases
tools.title: List phases
tools.description: List phases (tasks or stages inside a project). Time entries need a phase_id. API: GET /phases.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort by (see the API reference for allowed values).

tools.name: timeneye_list_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List time entries, filtered by date range, user, project, client, billing status or note text. Dates are yyyy-mm-dd. billed_status: 0 unbilled, 1 billed, 2 not billable, 3 billable. API: GET /entries.

date_from.description: Entries on or after this date.

date_to.description: Entries on or before this date.

client_ids.description: Only entries of projects of these clients.

billed_status.description: Billing status filter: 0 unbilled, 1 billed, 2 not billable, 3 billable.

text.description: Only entries whose notes contain this text.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort by (see the API reference for allowed values).

tools.name: timeneye_get_entry
tools.title: Get a time entry
tools.description: Get one time entry by id, with minutes, notes, billing state and tags. API: GET /entries/{entry}.

tools.name: timeneye_list_allocations
tools.title: List allocations
tools.description: List planned allocations (hours planned per user and project over time). Dates are yyyy-mm-dd. API: GET /allocations.

date_from.description: Only allocations ending on or after this date.

date_to.description: Only allocations starting on or before this date.

client_ids.description: Only allocations of projects of these clients.

tools.name: timeneye_list_time_off_requests
tools.title: List time-off requests
tools.description: List time-off requests the token can read, filtered by status and date range. scope 'can_see' is the default. API: GET /time-off-requests.

scope.description: 'can_see' (default) lists requests the caller may read.

date_from.description: Requests overlapping on or after this date.

date_to.description: Requests overlapping on or before this date.

direct_reports.description: Only requests of the caller's direct reports.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort by (see the API reference for allowed values).

tools.name: timeneye_create_entry
tools.title: Create a time entry
tools.description: Log time on a project phase for a date. Writes a new time entry in the account: minutes, date, project_id and phase_id are required. API: POST /entries.

user_id.description: The user who owns the entry (default: the token's user).

billed.description: Billing state: 0 billable, 1 billed, 2 not billable.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Timeneye
prompts.description: What you can do with Timeneye here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: log_time_on_a_project_for_a_day
prompts.title: Log time on a project for a day
prompts.description: Find the project and phase ids first. Then create a time entry with minutes, date, project and phase.

prompts.name: list_the_unbilled_time_for_a_client
prompts.title: List the unbilled time for a client
prompts.description: Find the client, then list its time entries for a period, filtered by billing status. Open one entry to read its notes.

prompts.name: compare_logged_time_with_project_budgets
prompts.title: Compare logged time with project budgets
prompts.description: Read projects with their billable flag and budget fields. Read the time entries of one project for the month.

prompts.name: check_planned_hours_and_time_off_requests
prompts.title: Check planned hours and time-off requests
prompts.description: List the planned hours per person and project. List the time-off requests in a date range.
